Selected outside sources

Editorial starting points, not a ranking.

  • ICM basics

    GTO Wizard · Free · Article

    An introduction to tournament prize equity, risk premiums, and the independent chip model's limitations.

    Before you use it: A model explanation is not a verified answer to an incompletely recorded hand.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • Satellite strategy: equal-prize tournament decisions

    Barry Carter / GTO Wizard · Free · Article

    Compare ordinary tournament incentives with equal-seat satellites using explicit stack and payout examples.

    Before you use it: Covers multi-seat satellites, not winner-take-all or target-stack formats. Examples are model-dependent; follow event timing rules.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing

  • Poker TDA rules and procedures

    Poker Tournament Directors Association · Free · Official rules

    Tournament rules, recommended procedures, and examples from the association that publishes them.

    Before you use it: Directly read the official 2026 rules, version 1.0 dated September 7, 2026, including procedures and the addendum. TDA rules supplement house rules; applicable agency rules take precedence.

    Public page read · 2026-10-07 · Full listing
